name: Dorn Plainstalker
summary: At the Weathered Nook, Dorn Plainstalker tests travelers who seek to prove their character and fortitude. The tauren elder guides Horde adventurers through rites of faith, endurance, strength, and lore, judging whether they are worthy servants of the Earth Mother and their people.

sections.title: Hermit of the High Cliffs
sections.body: Dorn Plainstalker lives in a shallow cave high on the Weathered Nook’s canyon ridges, apart from Freewind Post. Follow the northern cliffs above the towering mesas to reach his shelter. From this quiet vantage, he keeps ancient customs and judges those who seek guidance in the harsh southern barrens.

sections.title: The Four Trials
sections.body: Dorn Plainstalker guides pilgrims through four tests of a tauren champion: faith, endurance, strength, and lore. The trials ask aspirants to face fear, leap into the unknown, outlast cunning wilderness predators, and reflect on Kalimdor’s sacred history. Only then can they claim their final passage.

faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker is a tauren elder who lives as a hermit in the Weathered Nook, high above Thousand Needles. He leads traditional rites of passage for aspiring Horde champions.

faq.q: Where can I find Dorn Plainstalker?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker lives in a cave at the Weathered Nook. From Freewind Post, head north to the high cliffs bordering the canyon, then follow the ridge east to a ramp that climbs to his mountain sanctuary.

faq.q: What are the trials Dorn administers?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker oversees four sacred tests: the Test of Faith, Test of Endurance, Test of Strength, and Test of Lore. Completing them proves a traveler’s courage, physical resolve, combat skill, and respect for tradition.

faq.q: What is the Test of Faith?
faq.answer: The Test of Faith asks a pilgrim to step from a cliff plank into the chasm below. They must trust completely and overcome primal fear.

faq.q: Why does Dorn live alone in a cave?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker follows ascetic tauren spiritual traditions. He lives alone in the heights of the Weathered Nook, away from Freewind Post’s daily trade and defense, where he keeps a quiet place for contemplation and trials.

faq.q: Is Dorn affiliated with Freewind Post?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker lives outside Freewind Post, yet remains loyal to the Horde and the tauren tribes. He aids brave travelers who cross the windswept canyons.

angles.text: As a tauren wandering through Thousand Needles, you can see Dorn Plainstalker continuing nomadic ancestral traditions. His spiritual rites test your balance with the Earth Mother.
As a Horde champion, you are welcome to face Dorn Plainstalker’s trials. Warriors, hunters, and shamans of every race prove their mettle in Kalimdor’s rugged wilds.
